contea di ritrovamento: East Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

An early-medieval silver penny of Offa of Mercia (757-796), heavy coinage (c.792-796), mint: London, moneyer: Diola. This is a new type for Diola, comparable with North 321 (see notes below). Ref: Naismith and Naylor 2012, no. 21; North 1994: 89.
